canDoYue: 你識話吊墜跌壞、要書面估價同相片、問保單自負額，同埋星期五攞返。
canDoEn: Say the pendant was dropped, ask for a written appraisal and a photo, ask the policy excess, and collect it on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I dropped this gold pendant last night. Could I get a written appraisal?
dialogue.glossYue: 我尋晚跌咗呢條金吊墜。可唔可以出一份書面估價？
dialogue.say: I dropped this gold pendant last night. Could I get a written appraisal?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. I can write that appraisal once I have checked the bent pendant.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我檢查完條彎咗嘅吊墜，就寫嗰份估價。
dialogue.say: Yes. I can write that appraisal once I have checked the bent pendant.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could you take a photo of the crack for the claim form?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以影張相，影到裂痕，用嚟交理賠表？
dialogue.say: Could you take a photo of the crack for the claim form?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. This close photo shows that crack right beside the small gold clasp.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。呢張近相睇到裂痕就喺個小金扣隔離。
dialogue.say: Yes. This close photo shows that crack right beside the small gold clasp.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: What excess does my insurance policy charge for a repair like this?
dialogue.glossYue: 我份保險維修要畀幾多自負額？
dialogue.say: What excess does my insurance policy charge for a repair like this?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The excess on that policy is two hundred dollars for this repair.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢份保單嘅自負額係二百蚊，用嚟呢次維修。
dialogue.say: The excess on that policy is two hundred dollars for this repair.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can I collect the repaired gold pendant here on Friday afternoon, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以星期五下晝喺度攞返條整好嘅金吊墜？
dialogue.say: Can I collect the repaired gold pendant here on Friday afternoon, please?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. Friday is fine, and the pendant will be ready at four.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。星期五就得，條吊墜四點會準備好。
dialogue.say: Yes. Friday is fine, and the pendant will be ready at four.
